text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E in stages locked in gains, but I should base each sale on its outlook and portfolio role—not simply on the pleasure of realizing a profit.","A few months of account movements do not prove a strategy is working; I should assess risk and performance over a longer horizon.","When I rarely check or trade, I should still review whether my holdings remain diversified and consistent with my goals, rather than letting inaction become automatic."]}
